description: Implementation of LearningTaskControllerHelper class managing learning task observations, feature processing, and example handling in the media::learning namespace.

classes.name: LearningTaskControllerHelper
classes.description: Helper class for managing learning task observations, feature collection, and example processing.

methods.name: LearningTaskControllerHelper
methods.description: Constructor initializing the helper with a learning task, callback, and feature provider.

methods.name: BeginObservation
methods.description: Starts an observation with a given ID, features, and optional source ID, initiating feature prediction if applicable.

methods.name: CompleteObservation
methods.description: Completes an observation by setting target value and weight, then processes if ready.

methods.name: CancelObservation
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing observation by removing it from pending examples.

methods.name: OnFeaturesReadyTrampoline
methods.description: Static trampoline to ensure feature processing runs on the correct sequence.

methods.name: OnFeaturesReady
methods.description: Handles the event when features are ready, updating the pending example and processing if complete.

methods.name: ProcessExampleIfFinished
methods.description: Processes and adds the example if features and target are both done.
